description_en: Retrieves the change log of a table
description_zh: 该接口用于获取表的变更日志
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-meta-table-change-log --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --table-guid odps.engine_name.table_name --change-type ALTER_TABLE --object-type TABLE --start-date 2020-06-01_00:00:00 --end-date 2020-06-02_00:00:00 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetaTableChangeLog

parameters.help_en: The page number. Used for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The globally unique identifier (GUID) of the table. Format: odps.projectName.tableName. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780086.html to obtain the GUID of the table.
Currently, you can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780094.html to retrieve the change log of only MaxCompute tables
parameters.help_zh:
表的唯一标识，格式为odps.projectName.tableName。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780086.html，获取表的唯一标识。
当前仅支持调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780094.html获取MaxCompute表的变更日志
parameters.name: table_guid

parameters.help_en: The type of change. Valid values: CREATE_TABLE, ALTER_TABLE, DROP_TABLE, ADD_PARTITION, and DROP_PARTITION
parameters.name: change_type

parameters.help_en: The type of the changed object. Valid values: TABLE and PARTITION
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en:
The start date of the table change. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
If the date validation fails, the system uses the current time as the start date by default.
If both the start date and end date fail validation, the system automatically retrieves the table change records from the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
表变更的开始日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss。
如果输入的日期校验失败，则系统默认获取当前时间为表变更的开始日期。
当输入的变更开始日期和结束日期都校验失败时，则系统自动获取最近30天的表变更记录
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en:
The end date of the table change. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
If the date validation fails, the system uses the current time as the end date by default.
If both the start date and end date fail validation, the system automatically retrieves the table change records from the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
表变更的结束日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss。
如果输入的日期校验失败，则系统默认获取当前时间为表变更的结束日期。
当输入的变更开始日期和结束日期都校验失败时，则系统自动获取最近30天的表变更记录
parameters.name: end_date
